第 67 章 Physician, Heal Thyself!医生，医治你自己！

Jeff Foster / 杰夫·福斯特

— 第 190 页 —

There's no doubt about it, being an engineering manager can be a stressful role. Responsible for some combination of people, product, process, and the technology, you have many responsibilities, and if you're not careful, it's going to eat you alive. To be effective, you need to learn to manage yourself before you can manage others.

毫无疑问，做工程经理可能是一个有压力的角色。负责人、产品、流程和技术的某种组合，你有很多责任，如果你不小心，它会把你生吞活剥。要有效，你需要在管理别人之前先学会管理自己。

If you come into work feeling under pressure, you are going to transmit this to the rest of your team. If this sounds like pseudo-science, take a look at the research; emotional contagion is a thing. Research from Caroline Bartel (at New York University) and Richard Saavedra (University of Michigan) has shown that people share moods within hours. As an engineering manager you have the biggest influence in the team; people take their cues from you. You can't lead others when you're in the wrong frame of mind.

如果你带着压力来上班，你会把它传染给团队其他人。如果这听起来像伪科学，看看研究；情绪传染是真实存在的。Caroline Bartel（纽约大学）和 Richard Saavedra（密歇根大学）的研究表明人们在几小时内分享情绪。作为工程经理你在团队中影响最大；人们从你这里获取线索。当你心态不对时，你无法领导别人。

So, how do you look after yourself? First, make sure you work at a sustainable pace. Elon Musk might regularly work 100-hour weeks, but it's not a sustainable way to lead an organization! One of the principles I strongly agree with in the Agile Manifesto is to "promote sustainable development." As an engineering manager you should lead by example by working in a sustainable way. Don't answer emails at 2 a.m. or come in over the weekend, and definitely don't be the first one in and last one out every single day.

那你怎么照顾自己？首先，确保你以可持续的节奏工作。Elon Musk 可能经常每周工作 100 小时，但这不是领导组织的可持续方式！我在敏捷宣言中强烈同意的原则之一是「促进可持续开发」。作为工程经理你应该以身作则，以可持续方式工作。不要凌晨 2 点回邮件或周末来加班，绝对不要每天第一个到最后一个走。

Second, look after yourself physically. This doesn't mean running a marathon at 4 a.m. or anything heroic. Start simple; take a walk after lunch, play some sport or maybe go to the gym. Small changes make a huge difference. As Dr Nick Cavill says, "If exercise were a pill, it would be one of the most cost-effective drugs ever invented."

第二，照顾好身体。这不意味着凌晨 4 点跑马拉松或什么英雄事迹。从简单开始；午饭后散个步、做些运动或去健身房。小改变带来大不同。正如 Nick Cavill 博士所说：「如果运动是一颗药丸，它会是有史以来最具成本效益的药物之一。」

— 第 191 页 —

So far, so obvious. My final point is probably the most important but most neglected part of being a manager. Look after yourself mentally.

到这里都很明显。我最后一点可能是做经理最重要但最被忽视的部分。照顾好你的心理。

Mental health is just as important as physical health, but we don't do a good enough job of talking about it openly and honestly, nor do we take note of the real impact it can have on team performance. There's a stigma associated with mental health and it needs to be broken down. How can you look after yourself mentally? One key part of this is having regular one-on-ones with your manager. Regular one-on-ones should allow you to talk openly and honestly about the issues affecting you and (much more important!) how they are affecting you. This is easier said than done, and you'll need a high degree of psychological safety to do this. Building this degree of trust and openness with your manager will make it much easier for you to do the same thing with your team.

心理健康和身体健康一样重要，但我们没有足够开放诚实地谈论它，也没有注意到它对团队绩效的真实影响。心理健康有污名，需要被打破。你怎么照顾心理？其中一个关键部分是和你的经理定期一对一。定期一对一应该让你能开放诚实地谈论影响你的问题以及（更重要！）它们怎么影响你。说起来容易做起来难，你需要高度心理安全才能做到。和经理建立这种程度的信任和开放会让你更容易对团队做同样的事。

Another option is mindfulness training. If going to the gym works for your body, mindfulness does the same for your brain. How do you train mindfulness? One simple exercise you can try is just to take five minutes out each day to focus on your breathing. Find a quiet place, close your eyes and focus your attention on your breath. Be as curious as you can—what parts of your body move as you breathe? How is each breath different from your last? Try five minutes like this each day for a month and see whether it makes a difference for you.

另一个选项是正念训练。如果健身房对你的身体有效，正念对你的大脑做同样的事。你怎么训练正念？你可以尝试的一个简单练习就是每天花五分钟专注呼吸。找个安静的地方，闭上眼睛，把注意力集中在呼吸上。尽可能好奇——你呼吸时身体哪些部分在动？每次呼吸和上一次有什么不同？每天这样试五分钟，持续一个月，看看它是否对你有影响。

When you're confident that you have yourself looked after, help your team members look after themselves. Strive to create a psychologically safe environment in which people can share their feelings without fear of recrimination and you'll set the team up for success. Physician, heal thyself!

当你有信心自己被照顾好了，帮团队成员照顾自己。努力创造一个心理安全的环境，让人们可以分享感受而不害怕指责，你就为团队成功做好了准备。医生，先医治你自己！
